segments.name: Agricultural biotechnology
products: stacked traits of Bt and glyphosate tolerance genes
segments.description: Develops, produces and distributes corn seeds and genetically enhanced crop seed breeding technologies for farmers in the PRC.
segments.evidence: Our business focus is primarily on the corn seed development and distribution business and research focused on genetically enhanced breeding technologies in agricultural crops.

revenueModel.text: The company earns revenue by selling its crop seed products, including hybrid and genetically modified corn seeds, to farmers and distributors in China.
revenueModel.evidence: continuing our existing arrangements with farms that grow our crop seed products and entering into new arrangements with additional production farms

changes.text: In 2018, the company sold the subsidiaries Denong, Changchun Origin and Linze Origin under the first phase of the Master Transaction Agreement and terminated the second phase.
changes.evidence: In 2018, we closed the first phase of the Master Transaction Agreement and sold the subsidiaries Denong, Changchun Origin and Linze Origin.

changes.text: In 2024, the company established Beijing Origin Agriculture Limited as its primary operational entity and exited the Baodao Origin joint venture.
changes.evidence: In September 2024, Origin quit the joint venture.
